prompt:
A sprite sheet of 12 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 4 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) wooden dress-maker mannequin on a stand wearing a steel breastplate and a round steel helmet (armour display); 2) wooden display rack holding three shields: a round wooden shield with iron rim, a red kite shield, a blue heater shield; 3) tall wrought-iron floor candelabra with three white candles (unlit wicks); 4) wide stone fireplace with a wooden mantel shelf, stacked logs in the hearth (not burning), a few small jars on the mantel; 5) long wooden dining table with a loaf of bread, a wheel of cheese, two tin mugs and a bowl of apples on it (twice as wide as it is deep); 6) wide wooden shop counter / bar with a smooth top, carved front panels, two tankards and a small brass bell on top; 7) tall wooden shelf full of colourful glass potion bottles and flasks (red, blue, green); 8) wooden rack lying on its side holding three stacked ale kegs with brass taps; 9) wide double bed with a deep red quilt and two white pillows, head end at the top, wooden headboard (seen from above at a steep angle); 10) wooden spinning wheel with a stool; 11) two wicker baskets full of vegetables (carrots, cabbage, onions) and a loaf of bread; 12) small wooden writing desk with an open book, an inkwell and a quill.
Scale: the mannequin is about 40 art pixels tall, the fireplace about 56 wide and 44 tall, the dining table about 60 wide, the double bed about 48 wide, the candelabra about 36 tall; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Interior furniture of a cosy old medieval-fantasy village: homes, an inn, a tavern, an armour shop and an item shop.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt:
Generate a single transparent-background sprite sheet of EXACTLY 12 separate medieval-fantasy interior furniture props in premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. Arrange EXACTLY 3 COLUMNS × 4 ROWS in reading order, left to right then top to bottom. Give each object its own generously spaced cell; no overlap, cropping, text, labels, numbers, ground, cast shadows or drop shadows. All objects upright in classic three-quarter top-down RPG projection showing top surfaces and front faces, bottoms toward bottom (bed viewed steeply from above). Objects by row:
ROW 1: (1) wooden dressmaker mannequin on stand wearing steel breastplate and round steel helmet, (2) wooden rack displaying three distinct shields, round wood/iron rim, red kite, blue heater, (3) wrought iron floor candelabra with three WHITE UNLIT candles.
ROW 2: (4) wide stone fireplace, wooden mantel with small jars, stacked logs in unlit hearth, (5) long wooden dining table twice as wide as deep with loaf of bread, cheese wheel, TWO tin mugs, bowl of apples, (6) wide wooden shop counter/bar, smooth top, carved front panels, two tankards and small brass bell.
ROW 3: (7) tall wood shelf filled with colorful glass red blue green potion bottles and flasks, (8) horizontal wooden rack with three stacked ale kegs with brass taps, (9) wide double bed, deep red quilt, TWO white pillows at top, wooden headboard, steep top-down angle.
ROW 4: (10) wooden spinning wheel and stool as one isolated grouped prop, (11) TWO wicker baskets packed with vegetables carrots cabbage onions and a loaf of bread as one isolated grouped prop, (12) small wooden writing desk with open book, inkwell and quill.
Preserve sensible relative scale: mannequin ~40 art pixels high; fireplace ~56 art pixels wide by 44 high; dining table ~60 art pixels wide; bed ~48 art pixels wide; candelabra ~36 art pixels high. Use one uniform grid of large, crisp, identically sized square pixels over entire sheet (~6-8 image pixels per art pixel); hard pixel edges, manually clustered blocks of 3–10 art pixels, no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photorealism, texture noise or checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy worn-in materials, 4–6 distinct flat colors per material; shadows subtly saturated purple-red and warm-yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left ambient lighting, clean base colors, NO fire, flames, glow, light sources, pools of light, darkness or vignette. True transparent alpha background.
